title: Directional Bias in Quantile SGD and Score-Inversion Inference under Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2611.28367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantile stochastic gradient descent (SGD) tracks a quantile by comparing each observation with an adaptive threshold, and closely related updates calibrate online conformal sets and drive quantile temporal-difference learning. Their inputs are serially dependent, yet existing guarantees largely assume independence. We show that dependence creates a directional bias that score autocovariances cannot detect: reversing a stationary stream leaves every score autocovariance unchanged but can change the leading bias threefold. For finite memory and decreasing stepsizes, the bias splits into lag-specific interactions between the threshold and the current observation and a curvature term; delaying the threshold removes the interactions one lag at a time while keeping every observation and the leading variance. translated_title: 依赖条件下的分位数SGD中的方向性偏差与得分反转推断
translated_abstract: 分位数随机梯度下降（SGD）通过将每个观测值与一个自适应阈值进行比较来追踪分位数，与之密切相关的更新方法被用于校准在线共形集合并驱动分位数时序差分学习。这些方法的输入存在序列依赖性，然而现有的理论保证大多假设数据相互独立。我们证明依赖性会产生一种得分自协方差无法检测到的方向性偏差：将平稳数据流反转后，所有得分自协方差保持不变，但主导偏差却可能变化三倍。在有限记忆和递减步长的条件下，该偏差可分解为滞后特定的阈值与当前观测值之间的交互作用项以及一个曲率项；通过延迟阈值，可以逐个滞后地消除这些交互作用，同时保留全部观测值和主导方差。在步长接近 $t^{-1/2}$ 时（在线推断中常用的设置），该偏差与标准误相当，并会使基于SGD的区间（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文揭示了数据的序列依赖性会在分位数SGD中产生一种得分自协方差无法检测的方向性偏差（反转数据流可使主导偏差变化三倍），并将其分解为滞后特定交互作用项与曲率项，同时证明延迟阈值可逐滞后消除交互作用而不损失观测信息与主导方差。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that serial dependence induces a directional bias in quantile SGD that score autocovariances cannot detect—reversing the stationary stream can triple the leading bias—and decomposes it into lag-specific interactions and a curvature term, showing that delaying the threshold removes these interactions one lag at a time while preserving all observations and the leading variance.
